name: Spaceship c45a97a1 on 4.8.8
description: A period-4 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 8 to 9 cells, moving two lattice steps every 4 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B2/S2 to B25678/S25678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 3 times). A derivative ship (7f22824b with a tag-along): kept as a distinct object, not counted as a discovery.
